data.long_meaning: Mahendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Mahadeva, also known as Shiva. The name means 'great mountain' and symbolizes power, strength, and stability. Mahendra is the lord of mountains, and the name is believed to bring prosperity, courage, and victory. The name Mahendr carries the meaning “Majestic Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahendr usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
